module_summary: favsupport.cpp implements the Favourites page (FAV_MODE): the favourites.bin / recents.bin store (OFAV binary format, uOPL/wOPL import, staged .new writes with readback), resolution of stored records to live source lists, the FavSource GameSource that proxies launch/config/art/VMC to each record's source, the Recent stop and the All Games list gathered from every started source. folderbrowse.cpp keeps per-mode folder-navigation subpaths behind a single-instance FolderBrowse class wrapped by C forwarders. gamemanage.cpp implements Hide Game (per-device hidden.txt) and the Delete everything plan (parts, CFG, art, cheats). gamesource.h/.cpp define the GameSource base class (virtual source interface plus capability flags) and its defaults; hddsupport.h is the APA HDD source's public header (HDL game struct, POPS partition lists, module loading, OPL data-home selection).

findings.title: FolderBrowse class and folderbrowseint.h exist only to be wrapped by six one-line folder* forwarders
findings.problem: FolderBrowse has one instance (gFolderBrowse) and no user outside folderbrowse.cpp: every caller in the repo uses the folder* C functions, which only forward to the methods. folderbrowseint.h (38 lines, repeating the doc comments of folderbrowse.h) is included only by folderbrowse.cpp. The four guards also test mode < 0 || mode >= MODE_COUNT next to folderModeSupported(mode), which already rejects every out-of-range mode.
findings.fix: Delete folderbrowseint.h and the class; keep the three state arrays as file-static in folderbrowse.cpp and move each method body into its folder* function. Drop the redundant range test from the four guards (keep it in folderReset/folderConsumeDirty, which do not call folderModeSupported). Update .github/scripts/test_libview_l3_rescan.py, which extracts FolderBrowse::resetToRoot by name.
findings.benefit: ~60 lines removed (38-line header + ~29 lines of forwarders, minus 3 lines of static arrays); no ELF change expected, the forwarders are tiny (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep gFolderBrowse over src/RiptOPL: folderbrowse.cpp:13 (definition) and :25-50 (forwarders), folderbrowseint.h:36 (extern); nothing else. Grep folderbrowseint.h: only folderbrowse.cpp:7 and a docs mention. Callers in menusys.cpp, menuitems.cpp, opl.cpp, bdmsupport.cpp, mmcesupport.cpp, udpfssupport.cpp, bdmlaunch.cpp, supportbase.cpp, cfgtitle.cpp, favsupport.cpp all use folder* functions. folderModeSupported (folderbrowse.cpp:20) only accepts BDM_MODE..BDM_MODE_LAST, MMCE_MODE, UDPFS_MODE. Test reference: .github/scripts/test_libview_l3_rescan.py:38.

findings.title: favPrepareSave re-reads and re-parses the primary file that favReadFile just validated on every favourite/recent save
findings.problem: All three writers (addItem, removeByIdAndText, recentRecord) call favReadFile with editable and refuse to write unless it authorises the write; favWriteFile then runs favPrepareSave, which loads and parses the same primary (and staged) file again and recomputes the same decision (primary complete wins; else staged complete and primary missing or recoverable; else both missing). The only extra work it does is copying a complete .new back over a torn primary. recentRecord runs on every game launch, so each launch pays an extra open/read/parse of the primary before the two write+readback cycles.
findings.fix: Let favReadFile report which copy was authoritative (primary, staged, or none) and pass that to favWriteFile; restore the primary from the staged image only in the staged case and drop favImageValid and the primary re-read in favPrepareSave.
findings.benefit: ~15 lines removed and one fewer whole-file read (open, 2 lseek, read, tail read, close, about 6 IOP RPCs) of the memory-card file per favourite toggle and per launch (INFERRED from favLoadImage 344-373)
findings.evidence: Read favReadFile 395-423 and favPrepareSave 528-545: identical three-way decision on complete/missing/recoverable. Callers of favWriteFile: addItem 1050 (after favReadFile 1012), removeByIdAndText 1074 (after 1059), recentRecord 1516 (after 1492); grep favWriteFile shows no other caller. INFERRED: no other thread changes the config path or file between the two reads inside one call (the comment at 526-527 argues for re-reading across config-path changes and PC edits, which cannot happen inside a single save). Storage path: needs hardware testing.

findings.title: Unreachable defensive branches in favsupport.cpp: editable NULL tests and the selectedItemFlags mode fallback
findings.problem: favParseImage writes *editable unconditionally at line 231, and both callers (favReadPath 387, favImageValid 520) pass a non-NULL pointer, so the three later editable != NULL tests are always true. In selectedItemFlags, ownerView returns NULL only for an invalid index (already rejected at 962) or a NULL owner, and no record is ever stored with a NULL owner (ingest skips them at 835-839; favGatherAdd stores the non-NULL src from gatherPass 1627-1629), so the APP/HDD fallback at 971-977 never runs.
findings.fix: Delete the three NULL tests (keep the assignments) and the fallback block after the ownerView call, returning 0 when ownerView is NULL.
findings.evidence: Grep favParseImage: definition 226, calls 387 (&valid) and 520 (&complete) only. fav_rec_t.owner assignments: favsupport.cpp:845 (owner checked non-NULL at 835) and 1601 (owner = src, non-NULL by 1627-1629); gatherAllGames publishes rows only from favGatherAdd. ownerView 984-995 returns NULL only for !validIndex, NULL view, or NULL owner.

findings.title: FavSupport::artMode and FavSource::image duplicate the favourite-to-art-value match
findings.problem: Both loops decide whether favourite i matches an art value the same way: a name-addressed favourite matches on its text or on vcdExtractGameId(text), anything else matches when favOwnerHasId and the owner's startup equals the value. The two copies (about 10 identical lines each) must stay in step for texcache's device routing to agree with the actual read, as the artMode comment at 903-908 states.
findings.fix: Add one private FavSupport::matchesArtValue(int i, item_list_t *owner, const char *value) holding the match and call it from both loops.
findings.justification: The comment at 903-908 requires both to use the same matching; one shared predicate (about 12 lines) replaces two copies (about 20 lines), so it removes code and keeps the two paths from drifting.
findings.benefit: ~8 lines net removed; no measurable size change (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read 919-954 and 1321-1357 side by side: the strcmp/vcdExtractGameId block (936-941 vs 1337-1342) and the favOwnerHasId/startup compare (945-948 vs 1345-1348) are the same logic; only the action on a match differs (return mode vs call owner image).

findings.title: favStrdup and hiddenAppend re-implement strdup, which the rest of the repo already uses
findings.problem: favStrdup is malloc(strlen+1)+memcpy, and hiddenAppend does malloc+strcpy by hand; both behave exactly like newlib strdup, which opl.cpp:802, lang.cpp:181/494 and vcdsupport.cpp:312/334 already call.
findings.fix: Delete favStrdup and call strdup at its two call sites; use strdup in hiddenAppend.
findings.benefit: ~10 lines removed; a few dozen bytes of .text (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep strdup( over src: opl.cpp:802, lang.cpp:181, lang.cpp:494, vcdsupport.cpp:312, vcdsupport.cpp:334; favStrdup only at favsupport.cpp:47 (definition), 841, 1597.

findings.title: gm_delete_plan_t files[].what is written and never read
findings.problem: gmAdd stores what for each planned file, but gmDeleteExtras only unlinks path and menuDeleteEverything (menusys.cpp:446-500) reads only parts/cfg/art/cht/shared; the per-type counters already carry the type information.
findings.fix: Delete the what field and keep only the counter increments in gmAdd.
findings.benefit: 256 bytes less per heap-allocated plan (64 entries x 4-byte int, INFERRED) and 1-2 lines removed
findings.evidence: Grep '.what' / '->what' over src and include: only gamemanage.cpp:231 (write). gm_delete_plan_t users: gamemanage.cpp and menusys.cpp:451-475 (reads parts, cfg, art, cht, shared).

findings.title: CAP_SOURCE_ID / hasSourceId duplicate the default GameSource::sourceId
findings.problem: The only hasSourceId caller, libListSourceId, returns id when the flag is clear, which is exactly what the base GameSource::sourceId returns. Every source that sets CAP_SOURCE_ID (APP, ETH, BDM, HDD, MMCE, UDPFS) overrides sourceId, and the two that do not (HTTP, FAV) use the base default, so the flag never changes the result.
findings.fix: Delete CAP_SOURCE_ID and hasSourceId, call the virtual directly in libListSourceId, and drop the flag from the six constructors.
findings.benefit: ~4 lines plus six constructor flag terms removed; no behaviour change (READ)
findings.evidence: Grep hasSourceId|CAP_SOURCE_ID over src/include: gamesource.h:21,92; libview.cpp:160; constructors appsupport.cpp:598, ethsupport.cpp:215, bdmsupport.cpp:1566, hddsupport.cpp:318, mmcesupport.cpp:794, udpfssupport.cpp:224, each with a sourceId override (appsupport.cpp:1412, ethsupport.cpp:907, bdmsupport.cpp:1943, hddsupport.cpp:1905, mmcesupport.cpp:1098, udpfssupport.cpp:361). httpsupport.cpp:511 and favsupport.cpp:1108 set neither the flag nor an override.

findings.title: Stale includes of folderbrowse.h (4 files) and hddsupport.h (artload.cpp) that use nothing from them
findings.problem: Four files include folderbrowse.h with the copied comment 'folderDepth -- favourites suppression inside subfolders' but reference no folder* function or FOLDER_* constant; folderbrowse.h includes nothing, so nothing depends on it transitively. artload.cpp includes hddsupport.h 'for hddGetArtArchivePath' but never calls it (texcache.cpp does).
findings.fix: Delete the four folderbrowse.h includes. Delete the hddsupport.h include in artload.cpp after a build confirms it does not rely on the headers hddsupport.h pulls in (iosupport.h, hdd.h, mcemu.h).
findings.benefit: 5 lines removed; less rebuild coupling; no ELF change (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: grep for folderModeSupported|folderGetSub|folderDepth|folderDescend|folderAscend|folderReset|folderConsumeDirty|FOLDER_ in appscan.cpp, autolaunch.cpp, settingsio.cpp, lwnbdctl.cpp: only the include lines match. grep 'hdd|HDD_|HDL_|hdl_|APA_' in artload.cpp: only the include at :19 and a comment at :68. Transitive need of artload.cpp for iosupport.h/hdd.h/mcemu.h not checked (confidence Med for that one).

findings.title: Unused names in hddsupport.h: APA_IOCTL2_GETHEADER, HDD_LOADMODULES_STATUS_COUNT, hdd_loadmodules_status
findings.problem: APA_IOCTL2_GETHEADER, the enum value HDD_LOADMODULES_STATUS_COUNT and the typedef name hdd_loadmodules_status appear nowhere else in the repo; hddLoadModules returns int and callers compare against the other enum values.
findings.fix: Delete the macro and its comment, the COUNT value, and the typedef name (leave the enum anonymous).
findings.evidence: git grep -nw over the whole repo (sources, headers, modules, .github scripts, docs): APA_IOCTL2_GETHEADER 1 hit (hddsupport.h:17), HDD_LOADMODULES_STATUS_COUNT 1 hit (hddsupport.h:79), hdd_loadmodules_status 1 hit (hddsupport.h:80). Other enum values are used in hddsupport.cpp:597-698 and test scripts.

findings.title: Misplaced and stale comments in favsupport.cpp, folderbrowse, gamesource.h and hddsupport.h
findings.problem: favsupport.cpp:574-576 describes favResolve but sits above favFindVisibleSource (favResolve has its own comment at 689); :31 has two comments merged on one include line; :866-867, :1361, folderbrowse.cpp:9 and folderbrowse.h:16 name opl.c, themes.c and vcdsupport.c, which are now .cpp files. gamesource.h:64-66 documents ps1SaveDir but sits above rowPrefix. hddsupport.h:82-86 and :128-131 narrate the history of a removed macro and a review thread instead of describing the code.
findings.fix: Delete favsupport.cpp:574-576 and the stray half of :31, fix the file names, move gamesource.h:64-66 above ps1SaveDir (line 73), and cut the two hddsupport.h history blocks to one line each.
findings.benefit: ~10 lines removed; comments match the code (no ELF change)
findings.evidence: ls src/*/opl.c, themes.c, vcdsupport.c: none exist; src/app/opl.cpp, src/gfx/themes.cpp, src/sources/vcdsupport.cpp do. favResolve defined at favsupport.cpp:690 with comment at 689. gamesource.h:69 is rowPrefix, :73 is ps1SaveDir.
